summary: S2 (our 25-48) adapts manga 40-86 (LN vols 4-6): part 1 runs 40-71 ending on ch 71 'The Unleashed', part 2 runs 71-86 ending on ch 86 'The Octagram'. S3 (49-72) adapts 87-118 (LN 7-9) ending exactly on ch 118 'After the Festival' (matches the MU pin 118). S4 (73-96, 19 aired) adapts 119- (LN 10-11): ep 83 closes LN vol 10 at ch 130 and ep 91 sits at ~ch 142-143, only 2-3 chapters behind the monthly manga (ch 145, Aug 2026). Structure findings: the anime reorders freely - S2 opens with chs 40-43 that precede S1's Ingrassia chapters, the Falmuth-attack chapters 56-58 are shown before 54-55, ch 78 (Walpurgis entry) is deferred behind the battle chapters 79-81, ch 102 is split in reverse, and the Tengu chapter 105 follows the audiences 106. The three order-only entries (Visions of Coleus after S1, Scarlet Bond after S2P2, Tears of the Azure Sea after S3) are all Fuse-written originals with no manga chapters. Surprise: the context's volume boundaries are wrong (v1 is ch 1-6, not 1-4) - corrected map supplied.
